UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs government scheme for Emirati high-school graduates to study a Bachelor's degree abroad at any university on the MOFA-approved list. No institution is attached to the award: the applicant must already hold an unconditional acceptance from an approved university, and the ministry covers tuition only. Royal Society Career Development Fellowship is a four-year postdoctoral research funding scheme run by the Royal Society (a learned society, not a degree-awarding institution). No host institution or supervising professor is attached to the award - the fellow applies to establish their research at a UK institution of their own choosing ('Support talented early career researchers ... in taking the first step towards establishing their research in a UK institution'). Assessment is by a Royal Society panel, not programme faculty. Verified from https://royalsociety.org/grants/career-development-fellowship.
